subject: science
concept: Understanding the order and basic features of the planets in our solar system
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Earth and Space Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Earth's Place in the Universe) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student arranges planet models in correct order from the sun
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a planet to a basic identifying feature
exercise.abstract: Student names the planet that fits a given basic description

misconception_flags: places planets out of correct order from the sun

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
